name: athena
description: A cross-platform desktop examination and proctoring platform featuring exam integrity monitoring, camera and screen capture, instructor controls, and practical assessment support.

scripts.test: npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.dist:mac:demo: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=- --config.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.demo.plist --config.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.demo.plist

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Athena uses your camera during exams to take periodic photos for exam integrity, as explained before the exam starts.
